About Coursetakers.ae

Coursetakers.ae is more than a decade old course aggregator and Online course
platform that helps students find courses and compare course prices from
Training providers in the UAE, by just submitting their inquiry through the
website. Coursetakers also helps Institutes, Universities and Online
Instructors market their courses, gain leads and get more students to enroll
into their courses.
